description: This file defines the 'Field' struct used to represent a serialized field's header within the Orleans serialization wire protocol. It includes properties and methods for managing field metadata such as tags, types, and wire types.

methods.name: Field(Tag)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Field with a Tag, setting FieldIdDeltaRaw from the tag.

methods.name: Field(Tag, uint, Type)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Field with a Tag, an extended field id delta, and a field type.

methods.name: FieldIdDelta
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the field id delta, with logic for embedded or extended id.

methods.name: FieldType
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the field type.

methods.name: HasFieldId
methods.description: Indicates if the field has an embedded field id.

methods.name: HasExtendedFieldId
methods.description: Indicates if the field has an extended field id.

methods.name: WireType
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the wire type of the field.

methods.name: SchemaType
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the schema type.

methods.name: ExtendedWireType
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the extended wire type.

methods.name: IsSchemaTypeValid
methods.description: Indicates if the schema type is valid.

methods.name: HasExtendedSchemaType
methods.description: Indicates if the schema type is extended.

methods.name: IsEndBaseFields
methods.description: Indicates if the field marks the end of base fields.

methods.name: IsEndObject
methods.description: Indicates if the field marks the end of the object.

methods.name: IsEndBaseOrEndObject
methods.description: Indicates if the field is end of base or end of object.

methods.name: IsReference
methods.description: Indicates if the wire type is a reference.

methods.name: EnsureWireTypeTagDelimited
methods.description: Method to validate that the wire type is TagDelimited.

methods.name: EnsureWireType
methods.description: Method to validate that the wire type matches expected.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Override method to provide string representation of the field.
